profile.Name: Ears
profile.Personality: A chatty fixer known as 'the ears o' the Hounds' who sells newcomers an audience with Big Grim.
profile.Backstory: Go-between of the Hounds. Newcomers to Shark who want a gang's protection come to Ears, who arranges a meeting with Big Grim for a price.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Swamp slang: 'yah', 'right?', 'newbie'; 'you scratch my back, I scratch yours'.
